fusions.name: Spat Slug
fusions.desc: Fires a slug of glue and venom that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of the target's maximum health if it is a boss or elite, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Glue Buckshot
fusions.desc: Fires 3 pellets of glue in a tight spread out to 7 tiles, each of which deals 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Tripwire Charge
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to string a tripwire at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Holding Fire
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
